title: Pistachio Cannoli: Crisp Shells with Ricotta-Mascarpone Pistachio Cream
summary: Crisp homemade cannoli shells piped with a smooth ricotta and mascarpone cream full of pistachio, their ends dipped in finely chopped green pistachios.
equipment: sieve lined with muslin or kitchen paper
piping bag with a wide plain or star nozzle

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: 1 tbsp for the dough, the rest for sealing

ingredients.item: neutral frying oil (sunflower, rapeseed or vegetable)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Press the ricotta
steps.text: Wrap the ricotta in muslin or a double layer of kitchen paper and squeeze gently. Set it in the sieve with a small plate and a tin on top and refrigerate for 1 h so the excess liquid runs out.

steps.title: Shell dough
steps.text: Pulse the flour, sugar, salt and cinnamon in the processor, then add the coconut oil and pulse until sandy. Add 1 tbsp of the beaten egg along with the grape juice and vinegar and pulse until it gathers. Knead by hand for 4 min until smooth, wrap and chill 2 h; cover and chill the leftover egg. Resting relaxes the gluten so the dough rolls thin without springing back.

steps.title: Cut and roll
steps.text: Roll the dough to 3 mm and stamp out 8 rounds, then roll each one thinner, to about 2 mm, stretching it into an oval.

steps.title: Shape on tubes
steps.text: Wrap each oval around a cannoli tube and seal where it overlaps with a dab of beaten egg, pressing well. Work in groups of 4.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: With the oil at 175 °C, fry each batch for about 2 min, turning, until deep golden and covered in bubbles. Drain, let them cool briefly and twist off the tubes, then shape and fry the remaining shells.

steps.title: Beat the cream
steps.text: Beat the ricotta, mascarpone, icing sugar, vanilla and salt just until smooth and thick, then fold in the 50 g chopped pistachios. Keep the beating short, as mascarpone turns grainy if overworked. Chill.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Shortly before serving, pipe the cream into each shell from both ends.

steps.title: Coat the ends
steps.text: Dip both ends into the 40 g very finely chopped pistachios so they turn green, then dust the shells with icing sugar.

tips: Chop the coating pistachios almost to a powder so they stick in a bright green layer.
Avoid overbeating the mascarpone, a common mistake that makes the cream split and grainy.
Fill close to serving time so the shells stay crisp.
Unsalted, shelled pistachios give the best colour and flavour.

Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep unfilled shells airtight at room temperature for up to 2 days and the cream chilled for up to 2 days. Eat filled cannoli within an hour.
